name: 食堂メニューの提供元
prompt: Create ONE Japanese UI component LH19-0053: compact centered food-provider identity and information block. Pure white canvas, generous modest padding, no phone/full app screen, annotations or ID. Input1 ORIGINAL highest priority for star and map-pin glyph geometry, proportions, optical weight, alignment and fine details. Target original region x48,y738,w1083,h284 of1179x2676 image: title, rating line, address, small usage badge only. Input2 MOCK secondary content/layout only; it wrongly omits the star and pin, so restore these from ORIGINAL. Input3 comparison ORIGINAL crop LEFT and MOCK RIGHT. Input4 official white/forest-green/slate style. Preserve the Japanese demonstration content EXACTLY: heading ライトハウス食堂; rating line 評価 4.6 followed by small filled five-point star, then ・参考レビュー 1,500件; address line original teardrop map-pin outline with inner circular dot followed by 1階 食堂入口; compact badge 410人以上の利用記録例. This is sample content, not a verified real church review. Preserve centered hierarchy from original, with badge centered under address. No original restaurant name, distance/membership, branding/logo/banner because source record explicitly replaces/omits these in this demo component. White surfaces; ink#1D1D1D; secondary#6E6E6E; utility pin#526173, filled rating star#526173. Badge is white with fine neutral border and restrained forest green#1F6444 text, rounded6px; no broad mint panel. No primary action in this component, therefore do not invent green button. Meiryo headingBold20/28, bodyRegular14/24, metadataRegular12/16, tracking0. Compact readable composition around390 logical pixels wide, about160 high, enlarged crisp raster. Fine neutral borders and extremely subtle shadow only if needed. Keep balanced line spacing and correctly formed Japanese characters. Apple-like quiet hierarchy.
reviewNotes: originalをstar・pin形状と光学的配置の上位参照として評価。mock欠落の五芒星と内部dot付きpinを復元し、日本語の食堂名・評価例・1階 食堂入口・410人以上の利用記録例を保持。whitecanvasとforest文字badge、slateiconsを確認。日本語欠けなし。細いbadge境界は淡色で、厳密なMeiryo face/weight・native stroke寸法は未認定。所有者承認・編集・実データ/操作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
